meta: MediNova demo — see a full clinic day
title: See a full clinic day on MediNova
subtitle: Five screens, from a patient booking online to an invoice paid. Everything below is sample data — no account needed.
sampleNotice: Sample data. Nothing here is a real patient, doctor or payment.

scenes.name: Patient books online
scenes.blurb: A patient picks a department, sees real availability and confirms a slot in Bengali — no phone call needed.
scenes.canned: ফিভার এবং হার্ট রেট উচ্চ, মাথাব্যথা ৩ দিন ধরে।
scenes.statusHint: Confirmation sent by SMS and email

scenes.name: Reception checks in
scenes.blurb: Front desk sees today's queue, checks the patient in and prints a slip. No paper register.
highlights: QR check-in from the patient's phone
scenes.statusHint: Queue number displayed on the branch screen

scenes.name: Doctor records the visit
scenes.blurb: A structured consultation: vitals, complaint, examination, ICD-10 diagnosis and plan — captured as a defensible record.
highlights: SOAP note with vitals in one screen
scenes.subjective: Fever with body ache and headache for 3 days.
scenes.objective: Throat congested, no chest findings. Cervical lymph nodes mildly tender.
scenes.plan: Paracetamol 500 mg twice daily for 3 days. Plenty of fluids.
scenes.statusHint: Encounter closed and added to the patient record

scenes.name: Reception issues the bill
scenes.blurb: Line items, a discount and a payment — with the total reconciled to the paisa, never rounded by hand.
scenes.statusHint: Changing a doctor's fee later never rewrites an issued invoice

scenes.name: Owner checks the numbers
scenes.blurb: Appointments, revenue and busy doctors across every branch — with no other clinic able to see a row of it.
scenes.statusHint: A second clinic on the same deployment cannot read a single row of this data

ctaTitle: Ready to run your clinic on this?
ctaBody: Every plan starts with a 14-day trial. We help you import your doctors, schedules and fees.
